articles.title: How this Brampton community is making Halloween accessible for all kids
articles.summary: Community members in Brampton are aiming to make Halloween more accessible for children with mobility issues and other disabilities. They created a flat, low-barrier and low-sensory environment that mimicked a residential street where kids and their families could trick-or-treat and participate in activities.

articles.title: Driver facing impaired driving charges following 3 vehicle crash in Scarborough
articles.summary: One person is facing impaired driving charges following a three-vehicle crash in Scarborough.

articles.title: Is this Toronto's spookiest street? Meet the skeleton's of Pape Avenue
articles.summary: Houses along Pape Avenue, north of Queen East, are covered in skeletons posing in grand, creative, larger-than-life displays. CBC's Haydn Watters finds why the neighbourhood is so obsessed with skulls and bones.

articles.title: York Catholic school board chair contributed to ‘toxic environment': board’s integrity commissioner
articles.summary: The integrity commissioner for the York Catholic District School Board is taking disciplinary action against the board’s chair after an investigation fund she used “profane” language towards the former education director.

articles.title: Mississauga mayor-elect unveils transition team
articles.summary: Just days after his sizeable victory, mayor-elect Alvin Tedjo has unveiled the list of people who have joined his transition team as he prepares to take over the role of mayor from Carolyn Parrish in November.
